compute_ssim: compute the SSIM similarity metric between two PyTorch image tensors with configurable Gaussian filter parameters
generate_rays: generate perspective or equirectangular camera rays from image dimensions, focal length, and camera-to-world poses
pose_spherical: generate a spherical camera pose matrix from theta, phi angles and radius for NeRF-style rendering
get_expon_lr_func: create an exponential learning rate decay function with optional warmup delay for NeRF training optimization
jiggle_and_interp_poses: interpolate camera poses with cubic spline and add Gaussian noise for novel view synthesis trajectories
